 Two youth soccer tournaments coming to Snohomish County this Fall
 Lynnwood Times Staff 
 October 27, 2026 
 SNOHOMISH COUNTY — Everett will be hosting youth soccer teams from around the region this fall for two tournaments organized by Mukilteo Youth Soccer Club (MYSC) and Washington Rush . The Mukilteo Turkey Shoot, one of the most popular soccer tournaments in Washington, will be held on November 20-22 and will be followed by the Washington Rush NEXT GEN CUP on December 12-13, 2026. These tournaments will attract many youth athletes, parents, and coaches to local soccer facilities and will contribute to the development of Snohomish County as a youth sports destination.
 Youth soccer at Kasch Park in Everett. Source: Snohomish County Sports Commission 
 “It is exciting to have two youth soccer tournaments this fall,” states Tammy Dunn, executive director of the Snohomish County Sports Commission . “With Seattle hosting FIFA World Cup 2026® games in June 2026, it created “soccer mania” for the region. To have one of the youth soccer tournaments new for 2026 is a great opportunity for more youth to play soccer in Snohomish County.” 
 The Mukilteo Turkey Shoot tournament will offer recreational boys’ and girls’ teams of U9-U16 age categories for three days of the tournament. All the games will be played on Phil Johnson Ballfields, Everett, Kasch Park, Everett, and Lynnwood High School, Bothell. The tournament will include certified referees and a guarantee of at least three games per team where possible. Kasch Park will be the official tournament headquarters providing food and beverage vendors and merchandise. 
 After the Turkey Shoot, Washington Rush will host its first NEXT GEN CUP on December 12–13, 2026. The two-day event will have boys’ and girls’ teams in the age categories of U8-U12 and all matches will be held on artificial turf at Kasch Park Athletic Complex and Phil Johnson Ballfields located in Everett. Each team is guaranteed to play three games each and will have medal awards for winners and finalists.
 The teams wishing to participate in the Mukilteo Turkey Shoot can get information on the tournament, rules, and registration from www.mysc.org/turkey-shoot .  Registration for the Washington Rush NEXT GEN CUP can be done at www.washingtonrush.com/tournaments/next-gen-cup   Coaches and managers of teams can contact the concerned parties for more registration information. 
 Author: Lynnwood Times Staff
